Subject: Initial procurement ops playbook & vendor intake

Hi Vanessa,

We're ready to move forward with onboarding Redwood as a contracted supplier for our ML inference services. Can you send over your standard vendor intake checklist, W-9, and details on your PO & billing process? Our procurement team needs the following from you to start a PO:

- Completed vendor intake form
- Tax W-9 (or W-8 if applicable)
- Certificate of Insurance
- Remit-to billing contact and address

I've attached our internal W-9 and COI for reference. We expect to issue a PO for an initial reserved capacity trial once paperwork is complete.

Availability: can we target a 30-minute call tomorrow to review the items and estimated timelines?

Thanks,

Amy Li

Hi Amy — great to hear, and thanks for the attachments.

Quick summary of what we need from NovaCorp (what speeds PO issuance):

1) Completed vendor onboarding form (attached: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf). Please fill sections A (company details), B (tax), and D (remit/billing contact).
2) Electronic copy of signed COI and W-9 (looks like you attached both — thanks).
3) Purchase order terms: We accept PO + standard MSA. For first PO please include the estimated monthly spend and a billing cadence (monthly/quarterly).
4) Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Receivable, 1234 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103; invoices@redwood.com
5) Net terms: standard is NET30 unless finance approves NET45 for enterprise deals.

I've attached our vendor form and a short ops playbook that explains the PO flow, invoicing, and contact list.

Next steps:
- Can you complete the vendor form and return it by EOD Friday? (this will let our finance team provision the account)
- If acceptable, I'll loop in Marcus (finance lead) and Laura (contracts) to confirm the MSA/PO path.

I can do a 30-minute call tomorrow at 11:00am PT — does that work for you?

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Amy — looping in finance/AR notes here.

A few operational details to help NovaCorp's procurement team complete their PO:

- Invoice header must match vendor profile on the PO: 'Redwood Inference, Inc.'
- Acceptable PO reference: please include 'PO Number' and 'Project Code' (if available).
- Billing contact: invoices@redwood.com; please cc your NovaCorp AP contact on the first invoice so we can validate processing.
- Tax / W-9: PDF copy is fine. For international entities we'll need a W-8BEN-E.
- Insurance: COI should list 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' as certificate holder; if not, we can accept with a note on file.

DocuSign: if you prefer e-sign for the MSA, here's the link to the template we use: https://app.docusign.com/someDocId
HubSpot record for tracking: HUBSPOT-REC-789012

If you anticipate a large initial commit, please indicate projected start date so finance can queue provisioning for Dedicated capacity.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.com
